paragraphs: Apple has three new flagship iPhones launching next week: iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max and iPhone Ultra. Apple’s Pro models will have several advantages over the Ultra, but here are three ways the high-end Ultra will come out on top.
iPhone Ultra will have two displays with the following rumored dimensions:
This compares to iPhone 18 Pro’s 6.3-inch screen and 6.9 inches on the Pro Max.

Essentially, iPhone Ultra provides both a larger display than the Pro models and also a smaller one. As a result, it will be the better choice for anyone wanting the largest iPhone screen. But it could also be a winner for fans of small phones, like the discontinued iPhone mini.

iPhone 18 Pro, and especially iPhone 18 Pro Max, will be hit-or-miss in fitting pockets. This was already an issue with iPhone 17 Pro models. And while dimensions will largely be the same this year, rumors indicate the plateau could get even thicker to make room for the new camera system.
iPhone Ultra, meanwhile, will have a compact form factor when folded. It should fit in far more pockets with ease.
Additionally, the sleek, Air-inspired design of iPhone Ultra should be more comfortable in the hand than Apple’s bulkier Pro models.
Though iPhone Ultra will have a few hardware drawbacks compared to iPhone 18 Pro, it’s likely in the software experience that it will earn its ‘Ultra’ branding.
